runner.note: developer machine; comparable only with runs on the same machine under the same load

parameters.order: 5 reports merged in start order, so run k is the k-th one measured; within each report: runs interleaved: every cell of run 1, then of run 2, ...; a fresh server per cell

workloads.get: GET of a random key from a pre-written keyspace, one request per round trip
workloads.set: SET of a random key, one request per round trip
workloads.list: RPUSH then LPOP alternating on one list per client, one request per round trip
workloads.set-pipelined: SET of a random key, --pipeline requests per round trip
